title: Academic case reports lack diversity: Assessing the presence and diversity of sociodemographic and behavioral factors related to Post COVID-19 Condition
findings: The study found a significant scarcity and underrepresentation of 'Spiritual Beliefs' as a sociodemographic factor in Post COVID-19 Condition (PCC) academic case reports, being one of the least prevalent entities. The Named Entity Recognition model demonstrated strong performance in identifying these mentions when present (F1-scores of 0.87 for B-Spiritual_Beliefs and 0.98 for I-Spiritual_Beliefs). The Natural Language Inference analysis on the statement 'Is christian or catholic' revealed a mix of entailment and contradiction, suggesting mentions of non-Christian/Catholic faiths, though specific ratios were not detailed in the main text.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the model's ability to perform Named Entity Recognition (NER) for the 'Spiritual Beliefs' category within medical case reports. It also used Natural Language Inference (NLI) to classify these entities based on the statement 'Is christian or catholic', aiming to analyze historical privilege and potential discrimination in healthcare settings.
